messages:
Grace Park: hey folks, day 1 problem. Kandji enrolled fine but when i try to run Software Update to install Xcode it errors with "MDM policy blocks major OS install" and the GUI update is greyed out. i need 13.6.x for the toolchain. any safe way to get an exception?
Luis Hernandez: welcome @Grace! we lock major upgrades until security signs off because some upgrades change kernel behavior. we can either schedule a security-approved window to lift the block, or do a one-off remote install of the full installer via Kandji. which do you prefer?
Grace Park: i can wait a bit but would like the install done today if possible. what does the remote install involve?
IT Helpdesk Bot: Auto-check: device C02GRACE123 enrolled, policy: block-major-upgrade=true. Available actions: "request-security-exception" (requires SE approval), "remote-install-full-installer" (requires user consent & will run as admin). Ticket #ONB-10532 opened.
Nora Li: hi @Grace  quick note: remote install will download the full macOS image (~12GB) over your network. If you're on home/limited internet, better to schedule an office ethernet session. Also need temporary admin or we push the job that runs under our service account and then removes itself.
Grace Park: i'm at home with fast fiber so network isn't an issue. i'd prefer the job to run so i can get Xcode installed today.
Luis Hernandez: ok approving remote job. Nora will queue a Kandji job to fetch the full installer and run the upgrade. Grace, keep the laptop connected and do not interrupt power. We'll notify here when it's done.
IT Helpdesk Bot: Kandji job "remote-install-full-installer" queued by Luis Hernandez for C02GRACE123. Estimated time: 20-40min depending on network.
Nora Li: kicked off the job. command log excerpt: 
```
/usr/sbin/softwareupdate --fetch-full-installer --full-installer-version 13.6.1
sudo /Applications/Install\ macOS\ Ventura.app/Contents/Resources/startosinstall --agreetolicense --nointeraction
```
I'll watch the job and post updates.
IT Helpdesk Bot: Kandji job progress: download 12% -> 54% -> 100%. Installer launched.
Grace Park: getting a reboot prompt from the installer now. saving work.
IT Helpdesk Bot: Installer completed. System rebooted. Post-install check: OS version 13.6.1, Kandji agent running, profile intact.
Luis Hernandez: can you confirm Xcode now installs from App Store / xcode-select works?
Grace Park: opened App Store, Xcode started download and installed successfully. `xcode-select --install` also works. thank you! :tada:
Nora Li: great. i'll close ticket #ONB-10532 and add a small note to the onboarding doc: request office ethernet or schedule remote install for major OS needs.
Grace Park: adding that note now. appreciate the quick turnaround!
